079.csv::263.source_text:
最奥、《聖滝の間》に入るには
《水流制御室》で滝を止める必要がある――
079.csv::263.translated_text:
To enter the innermost area, "Holy Waterfall
Hall," you need to stop the waterfall in the
"Flow Control Room".
079.csv::263.speaker: Klaus

079.csv::264.source_text:
問題は"失われた鍵"の所在――
鍵がなければ、制御室へ入れないのだ
079.csv::264.translated_text:
The problem is the location of the "lost
key." Without the key, there is no way to
get into the control room.
079.csv::264.speaker: Klaus

079.csv::270.source_text:
魔物が湧き出てこないよう
正面門に通じる扉は封鎖しておこう
近くに開閉用のレバーがあったはずだ
079.csv::270.translated_text:
To prevent monsters from emerging, we've
blocked the door leading to
the main entrance.
There should be a lever nearby for
opening and closing it.
079.csv::270.speaker: Klaus

079.csv::272.source_text:
――ここにも無いとなれば
この階段を登った先、２階に違いない！
079.csv::272.translated_text:
If it's not here either, it must be on the
second floor at the top of these stairs!
079.csv::272.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::275.source_text:
部屋の前までは鍵を持っていたはずだが
通路の宝箱に手を伸ばしたときに床が崩れ――
079.csv::275.translated_text:
I would've had a key to the front of the
room, but when I reached for the treasure
chest in the corridor, the floor collapsed...
079.csv::275.speaker: Pamela

079.csv::276.source_text:
グリッテン砦正門が開き、
補給担当のジョナスが砦に配属されました
079.csv::276.translated_text:
The Fort Gritten main gate has opened, and
Supply Officer Jonas has been assigned there.
079.csv::276.speaker: Leo

079.csv::279.source_text:
"書き置き"
もし――ここまで探しに来てくれたなら
会いたいな
丘の上、崩れた教会で待ってるから
079.csv::279.translated_text:
Note: "If you've come all this way to find
me, I want to see you.
I'll be waiting at the ruined church
on top of the hill."
079.csv::279.speaker: Leo

079.csv::280.source_text: 封鎖エリア《メルゴダ護政区》開放
079.csv::280.translated_text:
The restricted area "Mergoda Security
District" has been unsealed.
079.csv::280.speaker: Leo

079.csv::284.source_text: 赤色症に効く薬草を入手した
079.csv::284.translated_text:
Obtained the herb effective
against red fever.
079.csv::284.speaker: Mayleaf

079.csv::286.source_text:
澄んだ青い光を秘めた石の欠片
"竜の泪"を見つけた
079.csv::286.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::316.source_text:
壁に文字が刻まれている――
"高貴なるサマラの指に輝きし光
我が心を魅了し、支配する光
輝きから逃れんと塔に身を隠すが
我が思いはひとときも離れず"
079.csv::316.translated_text:
There are inscriptions on the wall: "On the
noble Samara's fingers, a radiant light
shines, enchanting and ruling our hearts,
Though I hide in the tower to escape the
radiance, My thoughts never
stray for a moment."
079.csv::316.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::317.source_text:
床に文字が刻まれている――
"探究と秘密を愛する者よ
ここより北の洞窟で待つ
高貴なるサマラの指に輝きし光
人の目に余る煌めきサマラに帰るべし"
079.csv::317.translated_text:
There are inscriptions on the floor: "O
seeker of exploration and secrets; I await
in the cave north from here, where the
radiant light shines on the noble fingers of
Samara. Return to Samara with a brilliance
beyond human eyes."
079.csv::317.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::318.source_text:
石棺に文字が刻まれている――
"我が欲望は光に焼かれて人外となる
探究と秘密を愛する者よ、どうか我が身に平穏を
高貴なるサマラの指に輝きし光
人の目に余る煌めきサマラに帰るべし"
079.csv::318.translated_text:
Inscriptions are carved into the stone
coffin: "My desire is scorched by the light
and becomes inhuman.
O lover of inquiry and secrets,
please grant me peace.
The light that shone upon the noble Samara’s
fingers— A radiance too brilliant for human
eyes—must return to Samara."
079.csv::318.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::319.source_text:
冒険者の遺したメッセージとは
関係のない落書きのようだ――
079.csv::319.translated_text:
Looks like graffiti that has nothing to do
with the message left by the adventurer...
079.csv::319.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::320.source_text: 初代王サマラの指輪を入手した
079.csv::320.translated_text:
You have obtained the ring of the
first king, Samara.
079.csv::320.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::388.source_text: ――鋭いもので削られた跡がある
079.csv::388.translated_text:
—Marks of having been scraped by
a sharp object.
079.csv::388.speaker: Carrie
